title: Asiad podium remains elusive for Sanchez despite strong performance in 100m freestyle
summary: Kayla Sanchez narrowly missed the podium in the women's 100-meter freestyle after clocking 53.65 seconds in the 2026 Asian Games, at the Tokyo Aquatics Center on Tuesday.
